what: Photos scattered around the Hero’s four corners and sides fly toward the center after only 20px of scrolling, by 60~550% of their own size each, tilting ±8~10° and vanishing in .4s ease. Returning to the very top (within 20px) brings them back along the same path — a Hero where the photo collage is sucked in, leaving only the big title.

options.look: Position — tl·ml·bl·tr·mr·br (top left, middle left, bottom left, top right, middle right, bottom right). At 992px and above, tl·tr·bl·br sit farther out (210·180·200%)
options.past: Scroll px where fading begins, default 20
options.--fx-x · --fx-y · --fx-rot: When the position is set directly (style), it takes precedence over look

note: Since transform is used on this element, other transforms such as the hover tilt go on an inner element

from.where: index.html .se-stage__img six images — original template_hero-home-bis.js (scroll > If 20, js-anim-<Seat>) · template_hero_home_bis.css(.js-move-anim opacity·transform .4s ease, per-position translate·rotate, values for 992px and up)
